Reading / English:
かんさくせい
Kansaku-sei
Self-Protector
Core Traits (Corrected):
• Conceals inner self (内面を秘する) — exterior reveals little of rich inner world
• Late-bloomer fate: success comes slowly but powerfully (人生の歩みが遅い)
• Lone-wolf independence; enormous physical endurance
Strengths: Exceptional endurance; honest & direct; thrives autonomously; waits then acts decisively; late-bloomer power builds over decades
Weaknesses: Self-centered; inflexible; conceals inner self even from intimates; slow pace misread as laziness; friction with authority figures

Diplomat

• Soft exterior / hard inner core (外柔内剛) — NEVER reveals true feelings
• Active upward rebelliousness (目上への反骨精神) even while appearing agreeable
• 八方美人リスク: friendliness to all creates perception of insincerity

Reading / English:
ほうかくせい
Houkaku-sei
Free Spirit
Core Traits (Corrected):
• '食べるのに困らない' fate promise — will never go hungry; food/body are defining themes
• Endures SILENTLY (黙って耐える) rather than fighting — passive not active endurance
• '子供の星' (child star): eternally youthful; '長寿の星' longevity star

Weaknesses: Passive endurance only (not active persistence); appears unambitious; drifts without direction in youth; South position: drawn into opinions despite neutrality preference

The Artist

• Chooses solitude but SUFFERS in it (孤独を選ぶが苦しむ) — not peaceful independence
